questions.question: When King Jehoshaphat of Judah heard that a vast army was coming against him, what did he do?

answers.text: Set his face to seek the LORD
Called up every soldier in Judah
Sent gold to buy them off

questions.question: Facing a vast army, Judah heard from Jahaziel that the battle did not belong to them. Whose battle was it?
When Judah began to shout and praise the LORD, what did He do to the men of Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir?

answers.text: He sent hailstones down on them
He sent hornets out against them

questions.question: When Judah's men looked over the wilderness for the vast enemy army, what did they find?

answers.text: Only bodies lying on the ground
The army lined up for battle
An empty camp and fresh tracks
